description: Nieb Hasan Neom is a Computer Science PhD student at Missouri S&T who builds AI systems for high-performance networking and distributed computing.
bio: I build AI systems for high-performance networking and distributed computing, and I care as much about how they are engineered as about what they measure.

My research covers LLM agents that tune bulk data transfers from live TCP telemetry, guarded orchestration that lets scientists run trained models through natural language, and a benchmark that measures what domain adaptation teaches a language model about networking. I work in the Computer Systems & Networking Lab with Dr. Md Arifuzzaman.

Before the PhD, I spent three years as a backend engineer at Kona Software Lab, building Spring Boot microservices for a token-trading platform and a card personalization system that is now in commercial use.
availability: Seeking Summer 2027 research and research-engineering internships.
